name: naver-search
description: 네이버 웹문서·뉴스·블로그·카페·지식iN·백과사전·이미지·지역 검색 + 검색어 트렌드 · 쇼핑 인사이트 — 네이버 검색 + 데이터랩 API (NAVER API HUB). **텍스트·뉴스·해석** 용도 (시장 이슈·배경·리뷰·블로그·지식iN·백과사전·지역 등). 검색(search): webkr/news/blog/image/cafearticle/kin/encyc/local/adult/errata. 데이터랩: search-trend(검색어 트렌드), shopping-categories(쇼핑 분야별), shopping-category-by-device/gender/age(분야를 기기·성별·연령으로 쪼갬), shopping-keywords(분야 안 키워드), shopping-by-device/gender/age(키워드를 기기·성별·연령으로 쪼갬). ⚠️ 쇼핑·도서·전문자료 검색은 2026-07-31 종료돼 대체가 없습니다. **주가·PER·재무 같은 정확한 수치 파싱 금지** — 수치는 kiwoom/korea_invest 전용.

actions.name: 네이버 검색 (뉴스·블로그·카페·웹문서·지식iN·백과·이미지·지역)
actions.description: One search endpoint per `type`. Returns title / link / description plus per-type extras. Sort vocabulary differs by type and an inapplicable value is dropped with a note rather than sent. Shopping, book and specialist-document search were shut down on 2026-07-31 with no replacement — asking for them names that instead of failing vaguely.

params.type: webkr | news | blog | image | cafearticle | kin | encyc | local | adult | errata
params.display: Results per page (1-100; local is 1-5 and defaults to 1)
params.start: Paging offset (1-1000; local is fixed at 1)
params.sort: news/blog/image/cafearticle: sim|date. kin: sim|date|point. local: random|comment
params.filter: image only: all | large | medium | small

actions.name: 검색어 트렌드 (주제어별 통합검색 추이)
actions.description: Relative search interest over time for up to 5 keyword groups, each bundling up to 20 terms that are summed. Data starts 2016-01-01. ratio is scaled so the largest value in the window is 100 — it is not a search count, and two separate calls are not comparable. NOTE the `ages` vocabulary here is band numbers 1-11, which is NOT the decade scheme shopping insight uses.

params.keywordGroups: [{groupName, keywords[]}] — up to 5 groups, 20 terms each

actions.name: 쇼핑 분야별 클릭 추이
actions.description: Relative shopping click trend for up to 3 category codes compared against each other. Data starts 2017-08-01. Category codes are the cat_id in a Naver Shopping category URL. NOTE the cap is 3 here, not the 5 that search trend allows, and `ages` is the decade scheme (10/20/.../60).

actions.name: 쇼핑 분야 클릭 추이 — 기기별 분해
actions.description: One category's click trend split into PC and mobile series. Answers who shops this category, with no keyword involved. Each data row carries `group` (pc|mo), so rows repeat per period.

params.gender: m | f (a device filter would collapse the split)

actions.name: 쇼핑 분야 클릭 추이 — 성별 분해
actions.description: One category's click trend split into male and female series. Each data row carries `group` (m|f).

actions.name: 쇼핑 분야 클릭 추이 — 연령별 분해
actions.description: One category's click trend split by age decade. Each data row carries `group` (10|20|...|60).

actions.name: 쇼핑 분야 안 키워드별 클릭 추이
actions.description: Click trend for up to 5 search terms inside one shopping category, compared against each other. Unlike search trend, each group holds exactly ONE term — a second term in `param` is dropped. ratio is relative within each series, so a keyword at 100 is at its own peak, not the most searched keyword.

params.keyword: [{name, param:[oneTerm]}] — up to 5 groups, one term each

actions.name: 쇼핑 키워드 클릭 추이 — 기기별 분해
actions.description: One keyword inside one category, split into PC and mobile series. Distinct from shopping-category-by-device, which splits the whole category with no keyword.

actions.name: 쇼핑 키워드 클릭 추이 — 성별 분해
actions.description: One keyword inside one category, split into male and female series.

actions.name: 쇼핑 키워드 클릭 추이 — 연령별 분해
actions.description: One keyword inside one category, split by age decade.

action.description: API action. search=Naver search, search-trend=search interest over time, shopping-categories=category click trend, shopping-category-by-*=that category split by one axis, shopping-keywords=keywords inside a category, shopping-by-*=one keyword split by one axis

query.description: [search] Search term, UTF-8. Required for `search`; the DataLab actions ignore it

type.description: [search] webkr=web documents, news, blog, image, cafearticle=Naver Cafe posts, kin=Q&A, encyc=encyclopedia, local=places (max 5 results, WGS84 coordinates), adult=is this an adult term, errata=fix a keyboard-layout typo. Shopping / book / specialist-document search were retired on 2026-07-31 with no replacement

display.description: [search] Results per page. Most types allow 100; local allows 5 and defaults to 1

start.description: [search] Paging offset. Most types allow 1000; local is fixed at 1

sort.description: [search] Sort order, and the vocabulary differs by type: news/blog/image/cafearticle take sim|date, kin adds point (rating), local takes random|comment (review count). webkr and encyc take none. A value the type does not accept is dropped and reported rather than sent

startDate.description: [DataLab] Start date yyyy-mm-dd. Search trend goes back to 2016-01-01, shopping insight to 2017-08-01. Defaults to 90 days ago

endDate.description: [DataLab] End date yyyy-mm-dd. Defaults to today

timeUnit.description: [DataLab] Bucket size. date=daily (up to 1 year), week=weekly (up to 2 years), month=monthly (up to 5 years)

keywords.description: Terms in this group, up to 20; their searches are summed

keywordGroups.description: [search-trend] Up to 5 keyword groups compared against each other

param.description: Category codes — the cat_id in a Naver Shopping category URL (50000000=패션의류, 50000001=패션잡화, 50000002=화장품/미용, 50000003=디지털/가전, 50000004=가구/인테리어, 50000005=출산/육아, 50000006=식품, 50000007=스포츠/레저, 50000008=생활/건강)

category.description: [shopping-categories] Up to 3 category groups. This cap is 3, not the 5 that search-trend allows

categoryCode.description: [shopping-keywords / shopping-category-by-* / shopping-by-*] A single category code, e.g. 50000000

param.description: Exactly one search term. Unlike search-trend, this endpoint does not bundle terms

keyword.description: [shopping-keywords] Up to 5 keyword groups, one term each

keywordText.description: [shopping-by-device / shopping-by-gender / shopping-by-age] The single keyword to split

device.description: [DataLab] Device filter. Omit for all devices. On shopping-*-by-device this would collapse the split, so it is ignored there

gender.description: [DataLab] Gender filter. Omit for all. On shopping-*-by-gender this would collapse the split, so it is ignored there

ages.description: [DataLab] Age filter — TWO DIFFERENT VOCABULARIES share this field name. search-trend uses bands 1-11 (1=0-12, 2=13-18, 3=19-24, 4=25-29, 5=30-34, 6=35-39, 7=40-44, 8=45-49, 9=50-54, 10=55-59, 11=60+). Every shopping-* action uses decades 10/20/30/40/50/60 (10=10-19 ... 60=60+). "10" is valid in both and means 55-59 in one and 10-19 in the other, so a value carried across gives a plausible wrong answer; values that do not belong to the action are dropped and reported

items.description: [search] Results; extra fields vary by type (news adds originallink/pubDate, blog adds bloggername/postdate, local adds address/mapx/mapy in WGS84)

adult.description: [type=adult] Whether the term is an adult search term

errata.description: [type=errata] The corrected term, empty when there was no typo

ratio.description: Relative share, 0-100, where 100 is the largest value in this window. Not a count

group.description: [*-by-device/gender/age] Which split this row belongs to; rows repeat per period, one per group
